title: Local-First Command Kernel
summary: Local-first command kernel: kernel contracts in framework/core, hash/hlc/schema/sync crates, vcs causal undo on Edit/Checkpoint/Alternative, OpEnvelope hub transport, WIT plugin-world rewrite, sandboxed plugin host (fuel/epoch/supervisor), PluginHost invoke_command router + transactional hot-swap, render-plan validator, browser Worker isolation (opt-in). All 21 plugins build on default C-ABI; component_plugin_exports for wasip2 opt-in.
description: Rebuild plugin architecture into a local-first, schema-validating, capability-secured command kernel with sandboxed WASI P2 plugin components. Host owns state, windows, GPU, sync, validation, scheduling, permissions, undo, and plugin supervision.
